backend/main.mo: Implements user profiles, admin allowlist checks, signup flows, access‑controlled resets, and storage for users and service reports.
feature_evidence.json: Lists implemented features, associated frontend files, components, tests, and confidence metadata for product evidence tracking.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of major frontend files including hooks, pages, components, and utilities.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Documentation describing deployment modes, when to use them, and steps for mainnet publishing.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes with consistent UI tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures routing, authentication handling, profile gating, admin checks, and fallback screens for the main app flow.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Shows an admin‑only access warning with a button to navigate back home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Renders top navigation with role‑based menu items, responsive layout, and logout controls.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides the global page layout including header, content container, and footer branding.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Renders the login UI using Internet Identity, handling login flow, stale sessions, and account switching. Shows loading state and provides signup/login actions.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Handles user signup with form validation and role selection, submitting data to signup mutations including admin-specific logic. Displays errors, loading states, and collects user profile details.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Displays an error screen when the session is invalid and provides a button to trigger a full logout. Explains session issues and prompts re-authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes. Returns the active actor and fetch status.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Implements a complete logout flow by clearing identity, session storage, cached data, and reloading the page. Exposes a fullLogout function for components to trigger.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context using Dfinity AuthClient, managing identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking. Exposes hooks and a provider for Internet Identity integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profile, admin status, and signup operations, interacting with the backend actor and managing query cache updates. Includes logging and error sanitization for signup flows.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes with industrial color palette. Applies global styles and base component settings.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider. Loads global styles and renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface that lists users, manages deletion, purging legacy data, system reset, and navigation to user-specific reports with access control handling.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single service report with loading, error handling, and structured breakdown of report fields.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Form for creating new service reports with validation, submission, and success handling.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Lists all service reports with search, date filtering, optional user filtering, admin-only restrictions, and CSV download support.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Detects whether errors indicate missing user profiles or genuine authentication/session failures.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears Internet Identity-related localStorage and sessionStorage keys to fully reset authentication state.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Shortens a principal string for display by keeping leading and trailing characters.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Converts reports to CSV and triggers a downloadable file with generated filename.
Parses and sanitizes backend signup errors into user‑friendly messages, removing internal details and mapping known cases to clearer explanations.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Provides sanitized error logging and data‑redaction utilities for debugging the signup flow without exposing sensitive information.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Contains basic form validators for required fields, email format, and mobile number rules.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including session‑stored values and hash‑based routing cases.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS themes, colors, animations, and plugins used across the frontend.
project_state.json: Defines the project state, feature requests, and current issues focused on admin visibility and authorization fixes.
